records.question: Cual fue el crecimiento porcentual de ventas totales entre el primer trimestre (marzo a mayo) y el segundo trimestre (junio a agosto) del semestre?

result.model_output:
```sql
SELECT 
    (SUM(T2.amount) - SUM(T3.amount)) * 100 / SUM(T3.amount) AS percentage_growth
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            SUM(amount) AS total_amount
        FROM 
            sales
        WHERE 
            sale_date BETWEEN '2023-03-01' AND '2023-05-31'
    ) AS T1,
    (
        SELECT 
            SUM(amount) AS total_amount
        FROM 
            sales
        WHERE 
            sale_date BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2023-08-31'
    ) AS T2,
    (
        SELECT 
            SUM(amount) AS total_amount
        FROM 
            sales
    ) AS T3;
```

records.question: Cual fue el producto top en ingresos de cada trimestre del semestre, y cambio el lider entre el primer y el segundo trimestre?

result.model_output:
```sql
WITH QuarterSales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.name AS product_name,
        SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales,
        DATE_FORMAT(s.sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS quarter
    FROM 
        products p
    JOIN 
        sales s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
    GROUP BY 
        p.product_id, quarter
),
QuarterSalesRanked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_name,
        total_sales,
        quarter,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY quarter ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
        QuarterSales
)
SELECT 
    quarter,
    product_name,
    total_sales
FROM 
    QuarterSalesRanked
WHERE 
    rank = 1;
```

records.question: El ingreso de agosto de 2026 fue mayor o menor que el de marzo de 2026, y en que porcentaje?

result.model_output:
```sql
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sale_date) = 8 AND YEAR(sale_date) = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sale_date) = 3 AND YEAR(sale_date) = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS march_sales,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sale_date) = 8 AND YEAR(sale_date) = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sale_date) = 3 AND YEAR(sale_date) = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN MONTH(sale_date) = 3 AND YEAR(sale_date) = 2026 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
FROM 
    sales;
```
